self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 A Thousand Nights' Dawnsong: for each party member (other than the wielder) sharing the wielder's Elemental Type, the wielder gains 32 EM (max 3 stacks = 96 EM). The different-element half is different_element_ally_stacks. A party of three other members splits its stacks between the two, so the two states add up to 3. Quoted values are R1; refinementStates holds R2-R5.

R1 A Thousand Nights' Dawnsong: for each party member (other than the wielder) of a different Elemental Type, the wielder's DMG Bonus of their own Elemental Type rises by 10% (max 3 stacks = 30%). ownElement_dmg_ is folded into the scored character's <element>_dmg_ by the evaluator. The two halves' states add up to 3 for a full party. Quoted values are R1; refinementStates holds R2-R5.

en.flavor: This lamp illuminates the dreams that float up over a thousand nights, and in its emerald-green light flows a song of ancient days.

refinements.1: Party members other than the equipping character will provide the equipping character with buffs based on whether their Elemental Type is the same as the latter or not. If their Elemental Types are the same, increase Elemental Mastery by <r>32</r>. If not, increase the equipping character's DMG Bonus from their Elemental Type by <r>10%</r>. Each of the aforementioned effects can have up to 3 stacks. Additionally, all nearby party members other than the equipping character will have their Elemental Mastery increased by <r>40</r>. Multiple such effects from multiple such weapons can stack.

fr.flavor: Cette lampe illumine les rêves qui flottent sur mille nuits, et dans sa lumière vert émeraude s'écoule un chant des jours anciens.

passive.name: Chant d'aube d'un millier de nuits

refinements.1: Les autres personnages de l'équipe fournissent au personnage équipé de l'arme des bonus selon leur type élémentaire. En cas de type élémentaire identique à celui du personnage équipé de l'arme, la maîtrise élémentaire de ce dernier augmente de <r>32</r> pts. En cas de type élémentaire différent, le bonus de DGT élémentaires du type élémentaire du personnage équipé de l'arme augmente de <r>10 %</r>. Chacun des effets mentionnés ci-dessus peut être cumulé 3 fois maximum. De plus, la maîtrise élémentaire de tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité autres que celui équipé de l'arme augmente de <r>40</r> pts. Plusieurs armes du même nom peuvent permettre à ce bonus de se cumuler.

pt.flavor: Essa lanterna ilumina os sonhos que flutuam sobre as mil noites, e a sua luz esmeralda flui de dias antigos.

refinements.1: Os personagens da equipe além do personagem com esta arma equipada darão bônus ao personagem com esta arma equipada baseado no seu Tipo Elemental. Se o Tipo Elemental for o mesmo do personagem com esta arma equipada, aumentarão a Proficiência Elemental em <r>32</r>. Se o Tipo Elemental for diferente do personagem com esta arma equipada, aumentarão o Bônus de Dano Elemental do Tipo Elemental do personagem com esta arma equipada em <r>10%</r>. Os efeitos mencionados acima podem acumular até 3 vezes. Além disso, todos os aliados próximos exceto pelo personagem com esta arma equipada terão sua Proficiência Elemental aumentada em <r>40</r>. Os efeitos de várias armas com este mesmo nome podem ser acumulados.
